static_findings.finding: Training outcomes collapse to positive class 2.
static_findings.evidence: perform_action adds destination sugar to wealth; all 441 sugar values are strictly positive. Labels are sign(new wealth - old wealth) + 1.

static_findings.finding: Action selection ignores the positive class.
static_findings.evidence: Labels map negative/neutral/positive to 0/1/2, but confidence is output[1] - output[0]; output[2] is unused.

static_findings.finding: Wealth is cumulative and includes the training phase.
static_findings.evidence: perform_action uses +=; constructor trains after random actions without resetting wealth or positions before application.

static_findings.finding: Multiple agents may occupy the same cell.
static_findings.evidence: MultiGrid and unconditional move_agent; occupancy is an input but does not prevent movement.
Unpinned pip install mesa, no explicit Python or Torch versions, random seed schedule, recorded numerical targets, or multiple-run analysis.

interpretation: These are findings about this third-party notebook, not evidence contradicting Jäger. It is not accepted as a faithful replication implementation.

recovered_protocol.source_locations: Sections2.1–3.3, printed pages164–174; retained web extracts001/002.
recovered_protocol.sensors: Sugar and occupancy of current patch and four adjacent patches.
recovered_protocol.score: Sugar collected in the current turn, not accumulated wealth.
recovered_protocol.training: scikit-learn multilayer perceptron; held-out observations used for validation.
recovered_protocol.application: Reset agents, evaluate each action using P(positive)-P(negative), select maximum with random tie breaking.
recovered_protocol.competition_description: Repeated harvesting at a patch in the same turn reduces collection by the competition factor.
recovered_protocol.threshold_variant: First two agents sharing a patch receive full sugar; competition starts with a third agent.
recovered_protocol.advanced_experience: Execute the network-selected action; also evaluate a random different action counterfactually, storing its experience without executing it. Retrain iteratively.

claims_to_evaluate.claim: After20 application turns, agents cluster centrally without overlapping patches; last-turn sugar histogram is described as Pareto.
Random actions instead produce dispersed positions and an approximately Gaussian sugar histogram.
Without competition all agents reach the sugar maximum; held-out classification accuracy reaches100%.
For competition beginning at three agents, more random experience does not fix application performance despite high training performance.
Iterative advanced experience reaches a Nash equilibrium and average-score convergence after six iterations.

missing_fidelity_requirements: Author source, library versions, hidden-layer architecture, activation, solver, learning parameters and feature scaling.
Training/validation split, random seeds, repeated-run counts and exact Figure7 experience-size grid.
Within-turn scheduling, pre/post-action utility evaluation and whether penalties apply once or compound for subsequent harvesters.
Interpretation of the current agent in occupancy features, neutral-label tolerance and precise reset procedure.
Advanced-experience duration, replay-data retention, model reinitialization and convergence tolerance.
Original numerical figure data and distribution-fit procedure; visual histogram labels alone are not statistical goodness-of-fit evidence.
